mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_profile (merchant_id, legal_name, registered_country, industry, risk_level, tax_identifier, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{legalName}, #{registeredCountry}, #{industry}, #{riskLevel}, #{taxIdentifier}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE legal_name = VALUES(legal_name), registered_country = VALUES(registered_country), industry = VALUES(industry), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), tax_identifier = VALUES(tax_identifier), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
